summary: 60-year-old Texas woman took a 15-ft tumbling fall (initially reported at Sky Pond, determined to be at Lake of Glass, ~4.5 mi from the Bear Lake trailhead) and suffered several traumatic injuries; carried to a landing area on the east side of Lake of Glass and flown by St. Anthony Flight for Life to the Denver hospital
location: Lake of Glass, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP rangers; St. Anthony Flight for Life
notes: One of three incidents Mon Sep 12, 2011 per the Tue Sep 20 report (the two others: a 61 YOM food-allergy case treated on scene who declined transport — excluded per precedent — and the Alberta Falls item, id 2682); weekday-verified.
